subject.title: fix(agents): cloud thinking models time out at 120s during reasoning (#80349) [AI-assisted]

question: Should maintainers accept disabling the implicit cloud idle watchdog for non-off thinking runs once the Ollama cloud call-site bug is fixed and live proof is supplied or explicitly waived?
rationale: This changes default timeout behavior for existing cloud thinking users and can trade false timeouts for longer silent provider calls, so green CI alone cannot settle the runtime policy.

options.title: Fix, rebase, and require live proof
options.body: Require the call-site identity fix, a clean rebase, and redacted live Gemini embedded-run proof before merge.

options.title: Accept source proof after code fix
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept resolver-level proof plus the longer-silence default if live Google quota is unavailable.

options.title: Pause behind the issue
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it if the timeout-default tradeoff is not worth carrying without stronger evidence.

recommendation.title: Fix, rebase, and require live proof
recommendation.body: Require the call-site identity fix, a clean rebase, and redacted live Gemini embedded-run proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest recent routing owner for the timeout resolver and adjacent Google/runtime policy history among the likely owners.
